headline: Xi visits Egypt as China seeks deeper influence across the Mideast
context: China's President Xi Jinping visits Egypt this week for the first time in a decade. The trip illustrates China's growing ambitions at a time when U.S. influence has been weakened by its war in Iran.

sources.name: NPR
